summary: Situated within a peaceful and private cul-de-sac setting, just off the highly desirable North Road area of Darlington, this attractive two-bedroom end-terrace home offers a superb opportunity for first-time buyers, small families, downsizers, or investors alike.
description:
The property enjoys a quiet position while still being exceptionally well connected to a wide range of local amenities, including reputable schools, shops, supermarkets, and excellent transport links, making everyday living both convenient and practical. Offered to the market with no onward chain, the property has been tastefully improved by the current owner, most notably through the installation of a newly fitted contemporary kitchen and a modern, stylish bathroom suite. These upgrades add a fresh, move-in-ready feel to the home, allowing prospective buyers to settle in with ease. Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front, there is a neatly enclosed fenced garden area providing a pleasant approach to the home, along with a driveway offering valuable off-road parking. The cul-de-sac itself is particularly appealing, with a sense of community and minimal passing traffic, while at its end lies a well-maintained green space and public walkway, perfect for leisurely strolls, dog walking, or simply enjoying the outdoors in a quiet setting. Internally, the accommodation is well laid out and thoughtfully designed. The entrance hall provides a welcoming introduction to the home and leads into a spacious and light-filled lounge, which benefits from a comfortable living space and staircase rising to the first floor. The lounge flows naturally into the kitchen, which has been upgraded to a modern standard and offers a practical yet stylish space for cooking and dining. To the first floor, the property continues to offer well-proportioned accommodation, comprising two bedrooms, each providing versatile space suitable for sleeping, home working, or guest use, along with a beautifully updated family bathroom finished with contemporary fittings. Overall, this is a well-presented home in a sought-after location, offering a blend of modern upgrades, practical living space, and a peaceful setting. Early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate the quality and potential this property has to offer.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a UPVC-framed double glazed front door, creating a bright and welcoming first impression. The space benefits from practical laminate flooring, offering both durability and a modern finish. From here, there is convenient access to both the kitchen and lounge, ensuring a natural and well-connected flow through the ground floor accommodation.

LOUNGE The spacious lounge offers a comfortable and inviting living space, enhanced by attractive laminate flooring that adds a modern and easy-to-maintain finish. A UPVC-framed double glazed bay window allows an abundance of natural light to flood the room, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the day. The room also benefits from an electric heater, providing efficient warmth, while a staircase provides access to the first floor accommodation, neatly positioned to maximise the usable living space.

KITCHEN The newly appointed kitchen is fitted with a range of modern base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and stylish contrasting splashbacks, creating a fresh and contemporary feel. An inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap is set beneath a UPVC-framed double glazed window, allowing natural light to brighten the space. Appliances include an integrated oven and hob with an overhead extractor, providing a practical and well-designed cooking area. There is also plumbing in place for an automatic washing machine, ensuring everyday convenience is well catered for within this thoughtfully updated kitchen.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing provides access to both bedrooms and the family bathroom, forming a central connection point to the upper accommodation. The space is neatly presented and offers a natural continuation of the home's layout, ensuring easy and convenient access to all first-floor rooms.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a spacious double room, offering a comfortable and well-proportioned layout. A UPVC-framed double glazed window allows natural light to fill the space, creating a bright and pleasant atmosphere. The room benefits from laminate flooring, providing a modern and low-maintenance finish, along with an electric heater for year-round comfort. A useful built-in storage cupboard adds valuable practicality, helping to maximise the available floor space.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is a well-proportioned room, ideal as a second bedroom, guest room, or home office if required. It benefits from a UPVC-framed double glazed window, allowing natural light to brighten the space, along with laminate flooring that provides a modern and low-maintenance finish. An electric heater ensures the room remains comfortable throughout the year.

FAMILY BATHROOM The newly appointed family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite, comprising a panelled bath with an inset electric shower over, a wash hand basin, and a WC. The space is finished with part-panelled walls, adding a clean and contemporary feel throughout. A UPVC-framed double glazed window provides natural light and ventilation, while a wall-mounted LED mirror adds a stylish and practical finishing touch. Overall, the bathroom offers a fresh, well-presented space designed for everyday comfort and convenience.

EXTERNALLY Externally, to the front of the property, there is a neatly presented fenced and enclosed garden area, mainly laid to lawn, offering a pleasant and private outdoor space. In addition, the property benefits from a driveway providing valuable off-road parking, adding both convenience and practicality for everyday use.
